description:
Your service history, kept for good. On your phone, not on somebody else's server.

Most car maintenance apps ask you to make an account, sync to a server and hope nothing breaks. One bad login and years of service history are gone. Wrenchy works the other way round: no account, no server, nothing to sync. Every oil change, tyre rotation and MOT you log stays on your phone.

WHAT IT DOES
- Log oil changes, tyre rotations, brakes, filters, coolant, the MOT and anything else you care to type in, for as many cars as you run
- Get a reminder the day the next one is due, by date or by mileage, whichever comes first
- Log an MOT and the next one is set a year ahead, so the date you cannot legally miss sits on the phone rather than in your head
- See a car's whole service history on one screen
- Export the lot to CSV whenever you want. Export is free for everyone and never sits behind the subscription

WHY IT IS DIFFERENT
No account. No login. No server. No sync to break. Your service history cannot vanish, because there is nothing for it to vanish from. It is on the phone, the way the paper service book used to live in the glovebox.

BUILT FOR PEOPLE WHO KEEP THEIR CARS
- Every car you own, each with its own schedule and its own mileage
- Your own intervals for oil changes, tyre rotations, brake pads, air and cabin filters, coolant and the rest
- Due by date or due by mileage, whichever lands first
- Road tax, cambelt, air-con service: anything that comes round again can go in with an interval of your own
- Dark, glare-friendly screens, meant to be read on a driveway or standing at a garage counter

WHO IT IS FOR
Daily drivers, DIY mechanics, people running an older car on a budget, and anyone who will eventually sell or part-exchange. A dated, complete service history is the part of a used car a buyer will actually pay for; "I'm sure that was done" is not. Keep it in one searchable log instead of a folder of paper receipts and a shoebox of MOT certificates.

WHAT IT IS NOT
It does not plug into the OBD port, read your engine, look up your registration or book you in anywhere. It keeps the record, properly, and reminds you. That is the whole job.

Free for one car. Wrenchy Pro adds room for the rest of your cars and your own service intervals. Export stays free, for everyone.

whatsNew:
Glovebox is now Wrenchy.

Same app, same private service log with no account and no server. Only the name has changed — every record you have entered is still on your phone, exactly where it was.
